id.description: Unique identifier for the sponsoring pack

optional_options.description: Optional add-on options with all translations

flyer_template_url.description: URL of the uploaded PNG flyer template, or null when the pack is not flyer-enabled

flyer_zone_x.description: X coordinate of the logo zone in template pixels

flyer_zone_y.description: Y coordinate of the logo zone in template pixels

flyer_zone_width.description: Width of the logo zone in template pixels

flyer_zone_height.description: Height of the logo zone in template pixels
